scripts.dev: pnpm run clear && concurrently "cd frontend && pnpm dev" "cd backend && pnpm dev" "cd admin && pnpm dev"

scripts.check: oxfmt --check && pnpm --dir admin check && pnpm --dir backend check && pnpm --dir frontend check
